name: EPIC 247564120
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 11.8 solar radii and 1.48 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247564120 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.849195 (16th-84th percentiles 11.644996-12.298526), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247564120: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4957.391 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247564120 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4860.585938 (16th-84th percentiles 4793.90625-4942.578125), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.35 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 4,861 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.48 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,957 K at its surface.
